quarterly_data.quarter: Kostek Systems annual report: FY2025 business report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product pipeline: the HBM peel-off system removes temporary-adhesive residue from the device wafer after carrier debonding without damaging the TSV bumps; it was developed from September 2024 to October 2025 and is now delivered to Samsung Electronics for performance and mass-production-readiness testing, due to finish in June 2026. A UV de-taping system for Samsung's AI accelerator 2.3D packaging is under a 2025 joint evaluation contract with delivery scheduled for June 2026. The company names HBM makers Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Micron Technology and packaging houses Amkor Technology, Nepes and LB Semicon as the demand base for its temporary bonders / debonders, and is demonstrating a debonder to domestic 'Company S'.
quarterly_data.figure: Samsung HBM peel-off evaluation to finish June 2026; 2.3D UV de-taping tool delivery June 2026

connects_to.relationship: HBM peel-off system and 2.3D UV de-taping tool delivered to Samsung for joint / mass-production evaluation

contracts.source: Kostek Systems annual report: FY2025 business report (03-31-2026)
contracts.signal: Kostek signed a joint evaluation contract with Samsung Electronics for an HBM peel-off system in 2024 and delivered the mass-production evaluation tool in 2025; the R&D record lists the HBM peel-off system sale as a conditional sales commitment of KRW 1.5 billion. In 2025 it also signed a joint evaluation contract for Samsung's AI accelerator 2.3D UV de-taping system, with delivery scheduled for June 2026. Earlier (2022) it delivered a micro-LED vacuum aligner and pre-bonder to Samsung.
